name: tax-invoice
title: Tax invoice
for_each: select id, number from invoices where issued_on > hotel_today() - 30 order by number

sections.title: Invoice
sections.sql: select i.number as "invoice", i.issued_on as "date", s.business_name as "from", case when s.country = 'NZ' then 'GST number ' else 'ABN ' end || s.gst_number as "tax number", g.name as "to", nullif(concat_ws(', ', nullif(g.company, ''), nullif(g.address, ''), nullif(g.email, ''), nullif(g.business_number, '')), '') as "guest details", b.ref as "booking" from invoices i join bookings b on b.id = i.booking_id join guests g on g.id = b.guest_id cross join settings s where i.id = $1

sections.title: Accommodation
sections.sql: select n.rate_plan as "rate", min(n.night_on) as "from", max(n.night_on) + 1 as "to", count(*) as nights, round(n.rate_cents / 100.0, 2) as "per night", round(sum(n.rate_cents) / 100.0, 2) as amount from booking_nights n join invoices i on i.booking_id = n.booking_id where i.id = $1 group by n.rate_plan, n.rate_cents order by 2

sections.title: Other charges
sections.sql: select x.posted_on as "date", x.description, round(x.amount_cents / 100.0, 2) as amount from charges x join invoices i on i.booking_id = x.booking_id where i.id = $1 order by x.posted_on

sections.title: Total
sections.note: Amounts include GST. Where the law sets a reduced value for long stays, GST is worked out on that value.
sections.sql: select s.currency, round(f.total_cents / 100.0, 2) as "total including GST", round(f.gst_cents / 100.0, 2) as "GST included", round(f.paid_cents / 100.0, 2) as paid, round(f.balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as "balance owing" from invoices i join v_folio f on f.id = i.booking_id cross join settings s where i.id = $1

sections.title: Payments received
sections.sql: select p.paid_on as "date", p.method, p.reference, round(p.amount_cents / 100.0, 2) as amount from payments p join invoices i on i.booking_id = p.booking_id where i.id = $1 order by p.paid_on

name: registration-card
title: Guest registration card
for_each: select b.id, b.ref from bookings b where b.status = 'confirmed' and b.arrive_on between hotel_today() and hotel_today() + 1 order by b.arrive_on, b.ref

sections.title: Your stay
sections.sql: select v.ref as booking, v.guest, v.room_type as "room type", coalesce(v.room, '') as room, v.arrive_on as arrival, v.depart_on as departure, v.nights, v.adults, v.children, round(v.total_cents / 100.0, 2) as "total including GST", round(v.balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as "to pay" from v_bookings v where v.id = $1

sections.title: Your details
sections.note: Please check and complete. We use these details for your stay and your tax invoice only.
sections.sql: select g.name, g.email, g.phone, g.address, g.country, '' as "vehicle registration", '' as "signature" from bookings b join guests g on g.id = b.guest_id where b.id = $1

sections.title: Requests
sections.sql: select b.requests, b.eta as "arrival time" from bookings b where b.id = $1

name: housekeeping-sheet
title: Housekeeping sheet
for_each: select distinct property as id, coalesce(nullif(property, ''), 'All rooms') as name from rooms where active

sections.title: Rooms
sections.note: Rooms with a guest arriving first. Tick each when done and return the sheet to reception.
sections.sql: select room, status, housekeeping as "job", departs, arriving, eta, '' as "done by" from v_room_status where property = $1 order by case when housekeeping like 'clean now%' then 0 when housekeeping like 'check-out%' then 1 when housekeeping = 'stayover service' then 2 else 3 end, sort

name: fire-roll
title: Evacuation roll: who is in the building tonight
for_each: select 'tonight' as id, hotel_today()::text as name

sections.title: In house
sections.note: Print at the night audit and keep at the assembly point with your evacuation procedure. Tick each guest once they are accounted for.
sections.sql: select v.room, v.guest, v.adults, v.children, g.phone, v.depart_on as departs, '' as "accounted for" from v_bookings v join guests g on g.id = v.guest_id where v.status = 'checked_in' and $1::text is not null order by v.room

sections.title: Arriving later tonight
sections.sql: select coalesce(v.room, 'not assigned') as room, v.guest, v.adults, v.children, b.eta from v_bookings v join bookings b on b.id = v.id where v.status = 'confirmed' and v.arrive_on = hotel_today() and $1::text is not null order by v.room
